headline: Approved contracts for special event software, vehicles, landfill engineering, paving materials, and wastewater studies totaling over $1.1 million.
summary: The Finance Committee approved thirteen contracts and purchases, including software for special event permitting, vehicles for Fire Rescue, landfill engineering and gas monitoring work, paving materials, and wastewater studies. The committee also confirmed it complied with charter rules on the record of expenditures and held a brief non-public session on a real estate matter.
decisions: Approved a three-year contract with Event Approvals, Inc. for special event permitting software not to exceed $117,000.
Approved purchase of a Ford Transit Van for Nashua Fire Rescue not to exceed $77,277.28.
Approved purchase of a Ford F250 Super Duty truck to replace the Deputy Fire Chief's vehicle not to exceed $98,630.88.
Approved a contract with Stearns, Conrad, and Schmidt Engineers, Inc. for PFAS leachate removal infrastructure at Four Hills Landfill not to exceed $400,143.00.
Approved a contract with Sanborn, Head & Associates for FY2027-FY2029 landfill gas telemetry monitoring not to exceed $87,750.
Approved an engineering services contract with Sanborn, Head & Associates for 2026 landfill gas collection system modification design not to exceed $74,000.
Approved an engineering services contract with Sanborn, Head & Associates for the 2026 Phase III landfill temporary cap system not to exceed $46,500.
Approved purchase of trash and recycling carts and lids from Toter, Inc. not to exceed $145,000.
Approved sole source purchase of traffic signs and supplies from Perma-Line of New England not to exceed $38,000.
Approved sole source purchase of FY27 paving asphalt and aggregates from Brox Industries and Continental Paving not to exceed $147,000.
Approved Amendment #1 with ADS Environmental Services, LLC for collection system flow monitoring not to exceed $46,500.
Approved a contract with Hazen and Sawyer for a Nashua biosolids management feasibility evaluation not to exceed $116,462.73.
Approved Amendment #2 with Icon Architecture for a limited design study for a resource center not to exceed $40,000.
Approved that the Finance Committee complied with the City Charter and ordinances on the record of expenditures from August 14, 2026 through August 27, 2026.
